title: Fexofenadine and Pseudoephedrine
overview: The combination of fexofenadine and pseudoephedrine is used to relieve runny nose; sneezing; congestion (stuffy nose, sinus pressure); red, itchy, or watery eyes; or itching of the nose, throat, or roof of the mouth due to allergies. Fexofenadine is in a class of medications called antihistamines. It works by blocking the effects of histamine, a substance in the body that causes allergy symptoms. Pseudoephedrine is in a class of medications called decongestants. It works by causing narrowing of the blood vessels in the nasal passages to relieve congestion.
